component.name: Trading Platform
component.summary: Institutional-grade Algorithmic Trading Platform, Live Charts & AI Copilot

description.p: Trading Platform is a high-performance desktop trading terminal combining institutional-grade market charting, autonomous algorithmic rule scanning, risk management guardrails, and an integrated AI Market Copilot.

ul.li: Real-time Multi-Timeframe Candlestick Charts: 1m, 5m, 15m, 1h, 4h, 1d with sub-second price updates
Technical Indicators: Multi-period EMA (9/21/50/200), SMA, RSI, MACD, Bollinger Bands, ATR, VWAP
Autonomous Strategy Scanner: Visual rule builder with real-time signal generation across Forex, Crypto, and Equities
Capital Preservation: Configurable daily loss limits, maximum drawdown protection, and quick order execution
AI Copilot: Contextual market commentary and strategy explanations powered by machine learning
